name: naringenin
summary: Citrus flavanone from grapefruit and oranges with AMPK activation, insulin-sensitizing, and anti-inflammatory properties. Moderate human evidence; bioavailability varies significantly by form and gut microbiome.
description: Citrus flavanone reported to influence metabolic kinase signaling, including AMPK and PI3K/Akt, with potential effects on glucose and inflammation.
safetyNotes: well tolerated; possible interaction with drug metabolism enzymes; well tolerated; may interact with CYP450 enzymes | Citrus-derived compounds are generally food-associated, but grapefruit/citrus extracts can interact with CYP3A4/OATP/P-gp substrates.
